profile.headline: Senior Laravel & React Full-Stack Developer
profile.subheadline: 8+ years building web, mobile and industrial systems — ERP, HRM, supply chain, e-commerce and SCADA.
profile.summary: Senior full-stack developer with 8+ years of experience building web and mobile applications for businesses. I specialize in Laravel & PHP (bug fixes, APIs, e-commerce, ERP modules), React (admin dashboards, SPAs, frontend integration), Flutter (Android apps with Laravel/REST backends), and Node.js (REST APIs and real-time features). I have delivered production systems including multi-vendor e-commerce, food delivery platforms, inventory/ERP tools, live chat (WebRTC), and enterprise HRM & supply chain software. I deliver clean maintainable code, fast replies, clear updates, and on-time delivery.
